about: The save editor's place before Will (savedit.story_places on a room the game walks the player into): route29-official.sav put at the Will room's arrival (6, 22) by --before. Continue enters the room and its frame script (VAR_TEMP_x4001 at 0, as every entry leaves it) walks the player six tiles in, to (6, 16), where the place's 'walked' says the walk stops -- not before Will, who stands at (6, 10): the review's A there gave nothing. The five steps the place says are left reach the tile before him, and one A has him say his line (msg_0523_T10R0201 row 0, 523 << 16). A walk-in that ended elsewhere, or a count of steps that did not reach him, fails here.
